title: 1.5.23 Spot the Broken Pseudocode
description: A plan that never finishes, found by reading rather than running. Then fix it and prove it. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Say what is wrong
steps.instructions: The broken plan is in a comment at the top. In a comment of your own, say what is wrong with it. The answer is not a syntax problem.

steps.title: Write the fixed plan
steps.instructions: Write the corrected pseudocode as comments, with the missing step added and the indentation showing what is inside the loop.

steps.title: Implement it
steps.instructions: Turn your fixed plan into JavaScript with a while loop that counts and prints, and actually stops.

requirements.title: count starts at 1
requirements.description: Declares count with an initial value

requirements.title: A while loop with the condition
requirements.description: Uses a while loop testing count against 10

requirements.title: count is printed inside the loop
count actually changes
requirements.description: The missing step: count is increased, so the loop terminates

requirements.title: The diagnosis is written down
requirements.description: A comment explains that count never changes so the plan never ends
